about: Hand-authored classification ledger. Phase 2 of the documentation migration. scripts/docs/classify.ps1 merges it into the inventory produced by scripts/docs/inventory.ps1 and fails when a document is missing an entry, when an entry names a document that no longer exists, or when a live document under docs/ is absent from docs/README.md. Deciding what a document IS remains a judgement: it is written here so a reviewer can disagree with a line, not buried in a regex.

proposed_type.canon: Design truth. Lives in the design bible exactly once.
proposed_type.spec: Implementation-facing description of what the code does or must do.
proposed_type.roadmap: Sequencing and dependency order. Says when, not what.
proposed_type.guideline: How to do something: pipeline, conventions, patterns.
proposed_type.process: How the team and its agents work.
proposed_type.routing: Decides who works and what they read. Not a design source.
proposed_type.record: Dated audit, report, or decision history. Read-only after the fact.
proposed_type.generated: Produced by a script. Never hand-edited.
proposed_type.pointer: Stub whose content moved; maps old sections to their new home.
proposed_type.index: Table of contents for a directory.
proposed_type.archive: Historical source, consulted but never edited.

authority.derived: Must follow a canonical document; loses on conflict.
authority.historical: Describes a past state. Never wins over the present.
authority.generated: Measurement. Wins over prose about the same numbers.

action.keep: Stays where it is, as it is.
action.merge: Should be folded into another document.
action.split: Mixes two types and should be divided.

rules.note: Original Ravatha package, consolidated into bible chapters 06 and 13-21. Kept as the audit trail of that consolidation. Do not edit.
Canonical, tool-neutral skills and agent definitions. Governed by scripts/Sync-AgentContext.ps1 and Validate-AgentContext.ps1, not by this migration.
Mirror of .agents/ for Claude Code. Never hand-edit.
Mirror of .agents/ for Codex CLI. Never hand-edit.
Default for every bible chapter. Chapters with a narrower domain override this entry below.
Upstream license text and LPC credit data. Distribution obligation, not documentation.

README.md.note: Public face of the repository. Follows CURRENT_STATUS for the active increment.

AGENTS.md.note: Shares its source of truth with CLAUDE.md by design: same hard rules, different runtime. The duplication is deliberate and must stay synchronised by hand.

CHANGELOG.md.note: One entry per increment: what a player can now do, the schema range crossed, the measured baseline.

TO_DO.md.note: The single live task queue. 32 backlog markers here are the file working as intended, unlike the same markers inside a canon document.

docs/README.md.note: Authority rules plus the complete index. Rule 7 makes completeness enforceable; classify.ps1 enforces it.

docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.note: Carries 17 backlog markers: it describes the layout AND plans future work. The roadmap half belongs in TO_DO.md or a roadmap document; the description half is canonical for how the code is organised today. Split is proposed, not scheduled.

docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md.note: Hand-written claims about the live slice. Loses to session-state/STATE.txt on any measured number; the prose gets corrected in the same change.

docs/UI_PATTERNS.md.note: Read before authoring any screen or widget.

docs/UI_AUDIT.md.note: 27 backlog markers. Mixes a reusable manual checklist with a dated history of signatures. The checklist is a guideline; the history is a record; the outstanding items are backlog and belong in TO_DO.md.

docs/VALIDATION.md.note: Cross-check of the slice against the bible, with ranked gaps. Honest by construction: it exists to say what is missing.

docs/VISUAL_REGRESSION.md.note: Capture harness, required UI-state matrix, human sign-off contract.

docs/PERFORMANCE_BUDGETS.md.note: Frame-time targets and how the harness reacts when one is exceeded.

docs/ART_PIPELINE.md.note: Pixelorama to PNG to Godot, naming, wiring, anti-patterns.

docs/ASSET_INVENTORY.md.note: Inventory and licensing triage of downloaded packs, plus the staged integration plan.

docs/LINEAGE_DESIGN_MATRIX.md.note: Visual translation matrix for the LPC lineage pack. Derives from bible chapters 06 and 08; must not invent lineage meaning.

docs/MANIFEST.json.note: Machine-readable manifest for the 16 imported lineage character scenes.

docs/PRODUCT_DIRECTION.md.note: Core loop, validation sequence, drift checklist. Points to the bible for design answers.

docs/REPOSITORY_CONVENTIONS.md.note: The full prose behind the root routers. Explicitly loses to AGENTS.md on conflict.

docs/EARLY_GAME_RESOURCE_AND_EXPEDITION_.note: Approved direction for the opening arc. Cited as canonical by several CONTEXT_MAP routes, so it is canon for early-game numbers even though it is titled a proposal. EG-A0 figures remain provisional.

docs/EXPEDITIONS_AND_COMBAT_INTEGRATION_.note: Was docs/13_, which collided with bible chapter 13. It sequences work; the design it sequences is canon in bible chapters 05, 11 and 22. Sequencing is why it stays out of the bible.

docs/CITIZEN_OFFLINE_ROUTINE_AUDIT.md.note: Dated 2026-07-29, schema v19. Describes a past stabilisation pass; the current schema is v31. Never cite it for present behaviour.

docs/technical/sprite-generator-feasibil.note: Feasibility report, 2026-07-23. Separates verified facts from inferences and recommendations. Not an approved plan.

docs/GAME_VISION.md.note: Content moved to bible chapter 01. Kept as the old-section-to-new-home map.

docs/LINEAGES_AND_PROFESSIONAL_AFFINITIE.note: Content moved to bible chapters 04 and 06.

docs/DESIGN_INFLUENCES.md.note: IP boundary and naming discipline moved to bible chapter 01; the retired MVP shorthand stays here as a historical note.

docs/session-state/README.md.note: Explains what the generated baseline is and why it must not be hand-edited.

docs/session-state/STATE.txt.note: The measured baseline. Overwritten at every session start; wins over prose on any number it reports.

docs/ai/README.md.note: Entry point of the routing layer.

docs/ai/CONTEXT_MAP.md.note: Canonical for who works and what they read; never for what the game is. A route that does not exist must be added, not improvised.

docs/ai/AGENT_DISPATCH.md.note: Keyword and symptom table feeding CONTEXT_MAP.

docs/ai/CROSS_DOMAIN_INVARIANTS.md.note: Hard constraints with their sources. Canon even though it sits outside the bible: it states what no change may violate, gathered across pillars.

docs/ai/DECISION_LOG.md.note: Versioned decisions. Canonical because authority rule 1 is 'the most recent explicit decision wins', and this is where that decision is recorded. DEC-0011 is still Proposed.

docs/ai/AGENT_COLLABORATION_PROTOCOL.md.note: Single-writer rule, bug workflow, feature workflow, reviewer rule.

docs/ai/CURRENT_DEVELOPMENT_STATE.md.note: Third document answering 'what is built'. CURRENT_STATUS holds the prose and STATE.txt holds the measurement; this one drifts between them. Merge is proposed, not scheduled.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/README..note: Chapter order, authority hierarchy, and what is still open. The numbering note records why 11, 22 and 23 arrived late.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/01_GAME.note: Fantasy, single-city rule, absence rule, 14 principles, IP boundary.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/02_CORE.note: The nine pillars every slice is measured against.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/03_CITY.note: Macro view, parcel states, expansion, eight axes of growth.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/04_CITI.note: The single Citizen entity, five competence layers, twelve professional families, hero as a rank.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/05_EXPE.note: Automatic control, configuration surface, defeat consequences, the return leg.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/06_LINE.note: Index chapter for the eight lineages; the detail lives in 14-21.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/07_ONBO.note: Onboarding tone, the twelve choices, profile schema, founder influence.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/08_VISU.note: Three visual scales, typography hierarchy, Sixteen Pixel Perfect, per-lineage identity.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/09_AUDI.note: Synthetic retro direction and bus layout. No buses are wired yet; the chapter is ahead of the code.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/10_TECH.note: Its title admits the mix: canon for the stack and guard-rails, roadmap for the rest. Same split as docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and should be decided together with it.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/11_ELEM.note: Arrived from docs/11_ on 2026-08-07 into the slot the bible had left empty. Defines the common contract for the six affinities so no system turns them into six damage schools.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/12_DYNA.note: Frontage rows, reservations, footprints, corridors, and their persistence contract.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/13_KOVA.note: The shared mechanical system: three axes, six faces, eight vertices, derived stats, shadow mode.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/16_LINE.note: Kovari: culture, Cube applied to stats and builds, Cube vertex.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/19_LINE.note: Orveth: culture, Reliquary, Cube vertex. Kept its number; the first-night document is the one that moved.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/22_STAT.note: Was docs/12_, renumbered on 2026-08-07 because bible chapter 12 was taken. Canon for the shape of the stats; the v0.1 coefficients are balance and belong in configuration.

docs/world-of-goses-design-bible/23_FIRS.note: Was docs/19_, which collided with chapter 19 Orveth. Accepted 2026-08-06 under DEC-0014, and the only bible chapter currently cited by name from game code.
